description: This file contains unit tests for media support and key system support, including support checks for various codecs, resolutions, DRM systems, and performance testing of media capability queries.

methods.name: IsKeySystemWithAttributesSupported
methods.description: Checks if the implementation supports key system attributes with invalid attributes.

methods.name: GetDeviceType
methods.description: Determines device type (FHD, 4K, 8K) based on media support for specific resolutions.

methods.name: IsMimeAndKeySystemSupported
methods.description: Verifies if a given MIME type and key system are supported, expecting support.
